query: I accidentally hit a person with my car while reversing. What can happen under BNS?

gold_references.label: Section 125
gold_references.role: rash or negligent act endangering life or personal safety

acceptable_references.label: Section 18
acceptable_references.reason: accident exception may apply if the act was lawful, careful, and without criminal intention or knowledge

acceptable_references.label: Section 106
acceptable_references.reason: causing death by rash or negligent act applies if death resulted

acceptable_references.label: Section 281
acceptable_references.reason: rash driving or riding on a public way may apply if the reversing happened on a public way

wrong_references.label: Section 103
wrong_references.reason: murder requires intention or knowledge; pure accident does not attract Section 103

required_points: If no death results but danger or hurt was caused by a rash or negligent act, Section 125 may apply.
If the act was truly accidental without criminal intention or knowledge, and with proper care and caution, Section 18 (accident exception) may apply.
optional_points: If death results from a rash or negligent act, Section 106 may apply.
The final determination depends on whether the act was rash or negligent.
forbidden_points: This amounts to murder under Section 103.
An accident always results in no liability.

notes: Scenario query. Section 125 is primary because death is not stated; Section 106 applies only if death occurs, and Section 18 may apply if truly accidental.
